Name: Better Fishing
Author: balllight
Description:
Make fishing no longer a boring and tiring work.
Save your precious time and energy.
Let you enjoy your life in Pelican Town.


[b]Unbreakable Tackle:[/b] Tackles won't wear out. ( not vanilla but rational )

[b]Skip Fishing Mini Game:[/b] The perfect chance depends on fish difficulty, fish behavior, and bobberbar height. Stimulate the game progress as vanilla as possible. Only for ordinary fish.

[b]Skip Fishing Mini Game Of Legendary Fish:[/b] Literally.

[b]Junk Does Not Reduce Bait: [/b]Baits won't be consumed by rubbish. ( Baits attract rubbish? That's doesn't make any sense )

[b]Auto Reel In Fish:[/b] Reel in fish automatically when it nibbling.

[b]Auto Obtain Treasure Chest:[/b] Obtain treasure chests automatically.

[b]Auto Grab Treasure Loot:[/b] Grab items from treasure chests automatically.

[s][b]Always Perfect:[/b] Always be perfect if you skip the mini game.[/s]

[b]Always Cast Max Distance:[/b] Always cast the max distance.


Please comment if you have any suggestion or problem!
